name: GET /api/leadflow/routing/fair-share-audit - skew and starvation
description:
Distribution across the rep pool over 30 days.

STARVATION IS REPORTED SEPARATELY FROM SKEW, because they are different problems: a rep receiving far less than the mean has no pipeline and needs an intervention, while an uneven pool is a tuning question. Collapsing them into one "fairness score" loses the only distinction that changes what somebody does.

Reps with zero assignments do not appear in this window at all — they have no rows to group by — and the note says so rather than letting their absence read as fairness. The coverage console is where an entirely idle rep surfaces.

testCases.name: NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all
NEGATIVE: a bearer token that does not verify

errorCases.message: Authorization header with a bearer token is required
errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, empty, or uses a scheme other than Bearer.

errorCases.message: Session token is invalid or expired
errorCases.when: a Bearer token was presented but does not verify.
